concepts.title: Why sodium leaks must be detected

body.text: Sodium leak detection is important for three reasons:
Sodium systems run at low pressure, so under the leak before break approach:

checks.q: Why does the leak before break approach suit sodium piping?
o: Low pressure makes leaks generally small, so they can be detected before larger breaks
Sodium piping cannot leak at all
Sodium freezes at every leak and seals it
Water systems are routed beside the piping to detect leaks
checks.x: Because of the low pressure, sodium leaks are generally small and can be detected before larger piping breaks occur.

body.text: NRC training slides list these ways of detecting sodium leaks:
Double-walled piping may also carry leak detectors in the gap between the walls.

checks.q: Where are sodium conductivity probes usually located?
o: Inside the fuel assemblies
On the outside of the containment wall
In low spots below sodium-containing tanks
At the top of the cover gas space
checks.x: Leaks can be detected by conductivity probes, usually in low spots below sodium-containing tanks.

body.text: So the detector's circuit is normally open, and leaking fluid closes it. The lesson plan's diagrams are pictures and are not used.

body.text: The Sodium Leak Detection, Collection, and Containment System (NNA):
Sodium leakage from the reactor vessel into the guard vessel is watched through the cover gas system.

checks.q: What detection principle will Natrium sodium leak detectors generally be based on?
o: Conductivity detection with a self-test function
Ultrasonic detection
Neutron detection
Thermal expansion of a bimetal strip
checks.x: The PSAR says detectors will generally be based on conductivity detection with a self-test function.

checks.q: In the Natrium design, where are sodium leak detectors located?
o: Only on the reactor head
Only in the main control room
Only in the turbine building
Within leak mitigative features, at vulnerable valves, and inside catch pans
checks.x: Sodium leak detectors are located within leak mitigative features, at vulnerable valves, and inside catch pans.

checks.q: What do Natrium sodium leak detectors activate on detection of sodium?
o: A reactor scram
A water fire suppression system
A sodium dump to the guard vessel
An alarm within the main control room
checks.x: The sodium leak detectors activate an alarm within the MCR upon detection of sodium.

body.text: NNA leak detection signals support automatic actions for the primary Sodium Processing System (SPS-P):

items: NNA sends a signal to the Auxiliary Monitoring and Control System (AMC), which automatically closes the SPS-P supply valve.
AMC automatically trips the SPS-P pumps.
NNA sends a signal to the Utility Monitoring and Control System (UMC), which automatically closes NI HVAC dampers to isolate the SPS cells.

checks.q: At Natrium, which system automatically trips the SPS-P pumps on a sodium leak detection signal from NNA?
o: The Reactor Protection System
The Utility Monitoring and Control System (UMC)
The Nuclear Island Fire Water Distribution System
The Auxiliary Monitoring and Control System (AMC)
checks.x: NNA sends the leak detection signal to AMC, and AMC automatically trips the SPS-P pumps.

facts.q: Name five ways of detecting sodium leaks listed in the NRC training slides.
facts.a: Smoke detectors, contact detectors (spark plugs), cable detectors, aerosol monitors and inspections.

facts.q: What devices does Natrium SPS leak detection use?
facts.a: Devices such as wire and cable, spark plugs, and mutual inductance type sensors.

facts.q: What decides the type of sodium leak detector used at Natrium?
facts.a: The needs of the installation location and configuration.

facts.q: Where is smoke detection used for Natrium sodium leaks?
facts.a: In areas where sodium reactions may occur, such as Intermediate Air Cooling stacks.

facts.q: How is sodium buildup in the RV-GV annulus gas monitored?
facts.a: Through absolute filter differential pressure changes, oxygen concentrations and radiation levels.

summary.text: Leak detection matters because primary sodium is radioactive, sodium burns in air, and sodium loss could impair heat transport.
Detection methods include smoke, contact (spark plug), cable and aerosol detectors, and inspections.
In a spark plug type detector, leaking fluid completes an open circuit.

summary.text: Natrium detectors will generally use conductivity detection with a self-test function, and they alarm in the main control room.
Detection of small leaks helps prevent large leaks from occurring.
NNA signals drive automatic SPS-P valve closure, pump trip and cell damper closure.
